nina: FYI CI nightly SAST started failing after yesterday's RBAC cleanup. scanner logs show `KMS: permission denied (decrypt)` so tests that read protected fixtures can't run.
maggie: which SA?
nina: scanner-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com — looks like the KMS decrypt role was removed.
zack: saw more triage noise this morning, might be the same root cause. paste of CI error: ```Error: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = requestor does not have permission to perform action 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' on resource projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/app-secrets```
infra-bot: RBAC change recorded: @mike removed broad infra roles at 2024-09-18T02:14Z.
maggie: probable cause. temp mitigation: grant least privilege on the specific cryptoKey to the scanner SA (not project-wide).
security-oncall: please also verify Cloud Audit Logs for KMS decrypt attempts — compliance will want evidence. I can't find a decrypt entry for that SA window.
zack: ran: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"scanner-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"" --project=redwood-prod --limit 5` => no results.
nina: CI clearly shows permission denied. Maybe the call was blocked before reaching KMS, or logging sink excludes KMS methods.
security-oncall: action items: 1) infra to apply temporary scoped `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to SA (owner: @maggie) 2) infra to audit/enable KMS audit logs and retention (owner: @zack) 3) security to update scanner-runbook + PR checklist to require scoped key bindings (owner: @nina) 4) open incident ticket for CI break (owner: @nina).
maggie: creating PR with scoped binding and a GC policy to auto-remove temp grants. snippet: `resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "scanner_decrypt" { crypto_key_id = "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/app-secrets" role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter" members = ["serviceAccount:scanner-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"] }`
infra-bot: temporary grant created by @maggie at 2024-09-18T03:20Z (expires in 1h).
nina: CI rerun passed after temp grant :party_parrot: — can we keep it until PR merges?
maggie: will extend expiry and add reviewers: @security-oncall and @cloud-infra.
zack: I'll check the logging sink filters and retention; if KMS audit entries were excluded we'll enable and propose a backfill approach.
security-oncall: note in incident ticket: missing audit evidence + plan to harden sinks/retention. compliance will require traceback. Also add follow-up RFC to switch to per-environment CMEK and key access approvals to reduce blast radius.
nina: assigning owners in the ticket: infra (zack) logs, infra (maggie) RBAC PR, security (nina) runbook. Following up in #release-war-room if anything blocks deploy. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
